summary: The M2 checkpoint. You add a real model client behind get_llm_client, keep the API key in an environment variable that Git ignores, log one line per call (tokens and time, never the key), and test it all without a key using a pretend network.
goal: Call a real model from /api/chat with the key in an environment variable, log every call, and test it without a key.

items.text: Part A: confirm .env is in .gitignore, then create a provider key with a spending limit
Part B: write AnthropicClient with an LlmError and one log line per call
Part C: add the LLM_MODE switch, make /api/chat use the client, and match the fake answer in the test
Part D: write two tests with a pretend network and see all tests pass with no key set
Part E: make one real call, read its log line, then see a 502 with a wrong key
Part F: check git status does not list .env, update the README and push
Play the Key Keeper game to the end and see your score
